name: runner_3d
mechanic: inspired by Subway Surfers (2012, iOS): 3-lane endless runner. LEFT/RIGHT switch lane, UP jump, DOWN slide. Procedurally spawn box obstacles + collectible gems. Simplified to primitive geometry — boxes for player/obstacles, plane for ground.

name: box_pusher
mechanic: inspired by Sokoban (1982) in a 3D top-down view: grid puzzle, push colored cubes onto matching colored pads. LEFT/RIGHT/UP/DOWN move one tile, smoothly tweened. Deterministic, turn-based feel. Win when all boxes are placed.

name: ball_roller
mechanic: inspired by Super Monkey Ball (Dreamcast/GameCube, 2001): tilt-the-stage marble physics. LEFT/RIGHT/UP/DOWN tilt the platform; sphere rolls under gravity toward goal pad. Lose if it falls off the edge. Stage is a single primitive plane with simple obstacles.

name: tube_racer
mechanic: inspired by Tempest (1981 Atari arcade) and Tempest 2000 (Jaguar, 1994): ride along the inside of a procedural cylindrical tube. LEFT/RIGHT rotate around the tube axis, D fires forward. Collect rings, avoid wall spikes that scroll toward the camera.

name: drone_pilot
mechanic: inspired by Pilotwings 64 (1996) gyrocopter ring courses: fly a small craft through a sequence of ring gates. LEFT/RIGHT yaw, UP/DOWN pitch, D throttle boost. Depth perception via ring scaling and parallax of ground primitives.

name: cube_jumper
mechanic: inspired by Q*bert (1982 arcade): hop a cube across an isometric grid of platforms. LEFT/RIGHT/UP/DOWN move one tile diagonally, D jumps higher to clear gaps. Score for visiting new tiles, lose by jumping off the edge.

name: target_shooter
mechanic: inspired by Virtua Cop (Sega Saturn/arcade, 1994): first-person fixed-camera shooting gallery. LEFT/RIGHT/UP/DOWN move a crosshair, D fires. Sphere targets spawn at random depths and drift toward the camera; hit them before they exit the play volume.

name: maze_runner_3d
mechanic: inspired by Wolfenstein 3D (1992): first-person navigation through a procedurally generated grid maze. LEFT/RIGHT turn 90°, UP move forward one tile, DOWN move back. Reach the exit pad. Walls are flat-shaded boxes, no enemies.
